SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. .........
Section 1, Special Branch...Stated,
REPORT
Date September 20, 1939.

Subject. Job seekers from Ningpo.

Made by. D.S.I. Kao Yen Ken    Forwarded by R W Mac Culie D S I

With reference to the attached French Police
report dated September 18 on the subject of large
numbers of people arriving in Shanghai from Ningpo
to find employment and a telegram despatched by the
local Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association
requesting the people in Ningpo not to come to
Shanghai to seek employment, enquiries have been
made from the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association
and local shipping firms and show that shipping
between Shanghai and Ningpo has been irregular
and therefore the number of passengers on each
arrival or departure has been large. There has been,
however, no sign of large numbers flocking to
Shanghai for employment.

In view of the high cost of living in
Shanghai and the difficulty in securing employment,
the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association, 480 Yu Ya Ching
Road, addressed a letter to the Chamber of Commerce
at Ningpo on September 16, informing them of the
local situation and advising people not to come to
Shanghai to seek employment.

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH）
（批：Read 21/9）

Kao Yen Ken
D. S. I.

D.C. (Special Branch)

日期：1939年9月20日。

主题：来自宁波的求职者。

制作人：特别巡官 高恩肯 (Kao Yen Ken)    转呈人：特别巡官 R W Mac Culie

关于附上的法国警察于9月18日提交的关于大量人员从宁波抵达上海寻找工作的报告，以及当地宁波同乡会发出电报请求宁波民众不要来沪求职一事，经向宁波同乡会及当地轮船公司查询，显示上海与宁波之间的航运并不规律，因此每次抵离的乘客数量较多。然而，并没有出现大量人群涌向上海求职的迹象。

鉴于上海生活成本高昂且就业困难，位于虞洽卿路480号的宁波同乡会于9月16日致函宁波总商会，通报本地情况，并建议民众不要来上海求职。

（印：特别分支）
（批：9月21日阅）

高恩肯
特别巡官

副总监（特别分支）

9月16日凌晨约12点45分，一名约30岁的中国男子，由一名身穿广东丝绸马甲的人陪同，出现在海格路（Avenue Haig）的红十字会医院。他自称李永林（Ly Yung Ling，音译），浦东人，居住在海格路（越界筑路区）朱家角永兴里14号。他声称自己在午夜时分在家中被不明身份的人开枪击伤。伤口包扎后，该男子拒绝留在医院，并于凌晨3点左右离开。下午他又回来对腿部的伤口进行进一步包扎。

据信该男子是一名无业游民，遭人袭击以报复旧怨。

猪肉商与屠猪者。

9月16日，法租界猪肉商公会办事处的约20名成员在武利蒙路（Rue Vouillement）205弄13号的办事处举行会议。会议从下午4点持续到6点30分。

在讨论了增加屠猪费用后，会议决定由屠猪者代表陈金海（Chen King Hai，音译）于9月17日下午4点到办事处商讨此事。

在约定时间，办事处成员等待屠猪者代表的到来，但他未露面，猪肉商们讨论了局势，并同意将

pages.en:
-2-

the slaughtering of a pig be increased by 15 cents per
carcass and that this be notified to the pig slaughterers
on September 18.

On their side, the pig slaughterers are firmly
determined to charge $1.50 for the slaughtering of each pig
and in case this fee is rejected they will retain the offal
of each pig slaughtered.

The pork butchers threaten to institute legal
proceedings should the pig slaughterers retain the offal.

Job Seekers from Ningpo.

During the past few months large numbers of people
have been arriving in Shanghai from Ningpo to find employment.
As the cost of living here is very high and as there are
many unemployed in Shanghai, it has been very difficult for
these people to find work.

The Ningpo Fellow Provincials Association sent
a telegram yesterday to the Ningpo Chamber of Commerce
requesting it to advise people not to come to Shanghai to
seek employment.
pages.zh:
-2-

每头猪的屠宰费增加15美分，并于9月18日通知屠猪者。

另一方面，屠猪者坚决要求每头猪的屠宰费收取1.50美元，如果此费用被拒绝，他们将扣留每头被屠宰猪的内脏。

猪肉商威胁称，如果屠猪者扣留内脏，他们将提起法律诉讼。

来自宁波的求职者。

在过去几个月里，大量人员从宁波来到上海寻找工作。由于这里的生活成本很高，且上海有许多失业人员，这些人很难找到工作。

宁波同乡会昨天向宁波总商会发送电报，请求其劝告民众不要来上海求职。

SUBJECT : ARREST OF 4 CHILDREN AND 3 ADULTS FOR
HAVING TORN DOWN COPIES OF PROCLAMATION
DATED May 11, 1939

On May 14, 4 children and 3 adults were arrested
in the Joffre district for tearing down copies of the
Proclamation of May 11, 1939.

Questioned in the Political Section, WU I CHE
(吴一折), aged 11, born in Hankow, a scholar at
the Tung Yi Primary School (同义) and residing
with his mother at 42 Tai Ho Li, Rue Paul Beau, admits
having torn off a piece of the Proclamation for purposes
connected with the blowing of his nose. He did not know
it was an official document.

ZANG LENG DI (臧林弟), aged 9, born in
Ningpo, residing at 4 Chung An Li, Avenue Edward VII
admits having torn the Proclamation to amuse herself.
This young girl can neither read nor write.

WANG ZENG HWA (王增華) and WANG TSE HWA
(王滋華), brothers aged 12 and 11, living at 35
Joffre Terrace, scholars at the Teh Hua (德化)
Primary School, Rue Lafayette, deny have willingly
defaced the Proclamation. They state that it was only
stuck to the wall by a small corner and fell to the
ground as a result of inattention.

On instructions of the Chief of the Political
Section, these four children were handed over to their
parents who have been requested to come to this office
during the morning of May 15 when they will have to
furnish a shop security and pay a fine of $5.

of Anhwei, unemployed, states that he acted without
paying attention and that whilst passing he pulled

主题：逮捕4名儿童和3名成人撕毁1939年5月11日告示副本

5月14日，4名儿童和3名成人在霞飞路辖区因撕毁1939年5月11日告示副本而被捕。

在政治部受审时，吴一折（WU I CHE），11岁，出生于汉口，同义小学（Tung Yi Primary School）学生，与其母亲居住在保罗·博路（Rue Paul Beau）泰和里42号，承认撕下了一块告示用于擤鼻涕。他不知道这是官方文件。

臧林弟（ZANG LENG DI），9岁，出生于宁波，居住在爱德华七世路（Avenue Edward VII）众安里4号，承认撕毁告示是为了取乐。这名小女孩既不识字也不会写字。

王增华（WANG ZENG HWA）和王滋华（WANG TSE HWA），兄弟俩，分别为12岁和11岁，居住在霞飞坊35号，拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）德化小学（Teh Hua Primary School）学生，否认故意污损告示。他们声称告示只是用小角粘在墙上，因不注意而掉落在地。

根据政治部主任的指示，这四名儿童被移交给他们的父母，并要求他们于5月15日上午来到本办公室，届时他们需提供店铺担保并缴纳5美元罚款。

孙良鹏（SUN LIANG PANG），23岁，安徽人，失业，声称自己行为时未加注意，路过时拉下了

Anhwei, no fixed profession, residing at 55 Cheng King
Li, Rue Eugene Bard, denies having torn down the
Proclamation, and states he picked it up off the ground,
it having already been torn down. This man already has

LU AH LING (盧阿林), 32 years of age, dyer,

These three persons are being detained at

French Police Daily Report
February 8.

At the end of January, the Greater Shanghai City
Government balanced its books for the period since the
establishment of the Ta Tao Government (December 5, 1937)
up till the time of its organization into the present form
(October 16, 1938).

Receipts were :- $9,878,767.80
Expenses were :- $8,232,933.60

A representative of the Japanese Special Service took
the books away for checking purposes.
----------

The staff of the Reformed Government and the Greater
Shanghai City Government have requested the payment of an
extra month's salary as New Year bonus. On the advice of
Mr. Jen Yuen Tao, Head of the Pacification Department of the
Reformed Government, the Japanese Authorities have rejected
the request on the grounds of economy.
----------

Mr. LIU YU HENG, deputy-chief of the Administrative
Section of the Social Bureau of the local Government, has just
been appointed Chief of the General Affairs Section, replacing
Mr. HSU YANG TSE, who has taken over the post of Secretary-
General of the Hankow Municipal Government.

Mr. SHAO KIAI JEN, Secretary of the same bureau, has
been appointed assistant to the Chief of the General Affairs
Section, replacing Mr. CHEN HSIANG LING, detached to the
Hankow Municipal Government.
----------

Following the recrudescence of terrorism in the
Western Shanghai area, and particularly following the
assassination of KENG SHOU PAO (Chief of the Crime Branch of
Shanghai West), the Chinese Police officers in this area are
now armed with rifles.
----------

Instructional Note No.4.

Sieyes Refugee Camp - Beggars.

The Sieyes Refugees Camp will be structually altered
to receive about 500 beggars. A spot has been chosen,
isolated from the rest of the camp, that is closed on all
sides with bamboo fencing; the beggars, under no
circumstances, will be allowed outside, and they will be
placed under the permanent watch of policemen detached
from Foch Station under circumstances mentioned lower.

Beggars will be transferred to this camp as from
2 p.m. January 27. Each Station will use its own methods
for taking beggars to the camp, with the exception of
Poste de l'Est, which will borrow a truck from Mallet.

The Sub-Inspector from Foch Station will be present
to receive the beggars at the Camp.

Professional beggars, when arrested, will be placed
under disciplinary control after having been bathed and
deloused. Officers i/c Stations will see that certain
needy Chinese who beg occasionally are not placed in contact
with those who make begging their normal profession.

Personal possessions such as money, knives and, in
a general way, everything that is not required by the
beggars in their existence at the Camp, will be placed in
small bags and retained by a responsible employee designated
by the Camp management.

Upon their arrival at the Sieyes Camp, the beggars will
undergo an identification examination (a representation of
the Finger Print Bureau will be sent down to undertake these
duties).

P.A. to D. C. (Br. Br.)
28/

指导说明第4号。

西爱斯难民收容所 - 乞丐。

西爱斯难民收容所将进行结构性改造，以接收约500名乞丐。已选定一处地点，与收容所其他部分隔离，四周用竹篱笆封闭；在任何情况下，都不允许乞丐外出，他们将在下文所述的情况下，处于由福煦路巡捕房调派的警察的永久监视之下。

乞丐将从1月27日下午2时起转移至该收容所。各巡捕房将使用各自的方法将乞丐送往收容所，但东部巡捕房除外，该巡捕房将从马莱特 (Mallet) 处借用一辆卡车。

福煦路巡捕房的副督察将到场在收容所接收乞丐。

职业乞丐被捕后，将在沐浴和除虱后置于纪律管制之下。各巡捕房主管须确保某些偶尔乞讨的贫困中国人不与以乞讨为正常职业的人接触。

个人物品如金钱、刀具以及一般而言乞丐在收容所生活中不需要的一切物品，将装入小袋中，并由收容所管理层指定的负责雇员保管。

乞丐抵达西爱斯收容所后，将进行身份识别检查（指纹局将派代表前来执行这些任务）。

SERVICES DE POLICE

Changhai, le 20 Janvier 1939

NOTE DE SERVICE N° 4
----------

Envoi de mendiants au Camp de Réfugiés Siéyès
&&&:

Le Camp de réfugiés Siéyès va être aménagé pour rece-
voir environ 500 mendiants. Un endroit a été choisi où sont
érigées des paillotes solidement clôturées et isolées du
reste du camp : les mendiants ne pourront, en aucun cas,
gagner l'extérieur, et ils seront placés sous la surveillan-
ce permanente d'agents détachés du Poste Foch dans les condi-
tions exposées plus loin.

Le transport commencera Vendredi, 27 à 14 heures. Chaque
Poste conduira ses mendiants par ses propres moyens, à l'ex-
ception du Poste de l'Est qui disposera d'un camion de Mallet

Le Sous-Inspecteur du Poste Foch sera présent pour la
réception des mendiants au camp.

Les mendiants professionnels qui seront appréhendés, dès
à présent, seront conservés dans les locaux disciplinaires,
après avoir été soumis à la douche et à l'épouillage. Les
Chefs de Postes veilleront à ce que certains Chinois nécessi-
teux se livrant occasionnellement à la mendicité ne soient
pas mélangés à ceux qui en font leur occupation normale.

Les objets personnels tels que, argent, couteaux, et
en général tout ce qui ne sera pas indispensable à la sub-
sistance des mendiants au camp Siéyès seront mis dans des
pochettes et confiés à un employé responsable désigné par
la direction du camp.

Dès leur arrivée au camp Siéyès, les mendiants seront
soumis à un examen d'identité (l Agent de l'Identité Judi-
ciaire sera désigné à cet effet).

CORPS DE GARDE

Six Agents Chinois et un Brigadier du Poste Foch cons-
titueront un corps de garde permanent et seront relevés tou-
tes les 24 heures, le matin à 8 h.30. Deux d'entre eux
seront de service sous la surveillance du Brigadier qui
effectuera des rondes fréquentes dans le Camp. Un local sera
mis à la disposition des 4 Agents non de service et du Bri-
gadier pour y prendre leur repas et s'y tenir en réserve.
Ils devront pouvoir être trouvés en tenue à toute heure du
jour ou de la nuit. Du matériel de couchage et un poêle
seront fournis par le Magasin. Le charbon sera pris au
Poste Foch.

发送乞丐至西爱斯难民收容所
&&&:

西爱斯难民收容所将进行改造，以接收约500名乞丐。已选定一处地点，建有牢固围闭并与收容所其余部分隔离的草棚：乞丐在任何情况下都不得离开到外部，他们将在下文所述条件下，处于由福煦路巡捕房调派的警员的永久监视之下。

运输将于周五，即27日14时开始。各巡捕房将通过自有手段运送其管辖范围内的乞丐，东部巡捕房除外，该巡捕房将使用马莱特的一辆卡车。

福煦路巡捕房的副督察将到场在收容所接收乞丐。

目前被捕的职业乞丐，在经过淋浴和除虱后，将被关押在纪律拘禁室。各巡捕房主管须注意，不要将某些偶尔从事乞讨的贫困中国人与以乞讨为正常职业的人混在一起。

个人物品如金钱、刀具以及一般而言对乞丐在西爱斯收容所生存非必需的一切物品，将放入小袋中，并交由收容所管理层指定的负责雇员保管。

乞丐一抵达西爱斯收容所，就将接受身份检查（为此将指派司法身份鉴定专员）。

警卫队

六名中国警员和一名来自福煦路巡捕房的警长将组成永久警卫队，并每24小时在上午8时30分换班。其中两人将在警长的监视下值班，警长将在收容所内频繁巡视。将为4名不当班警员和警长提供一间房间，供其用餐和备勤。他们必须能在白天或夜晚的任何时候身着制服被找到。寝具和火炉将由库房提供。煤炭将从福煦路巡捕房领取。

大上海特别市秘书长苏新文（SU HSINH WEN，音译）先生将于今日启程前往东京，出席一次经济会议。他将由维新政府实业部部长王泽辉（WANG TSE HUI，音译）先生陪同。实际上，据信其意图是进行活动以谋求汉口市市长一职。
C.D.S.
有传言持续称，尽管表面上他们维持着良好关系，但他与傅筱庵（FU HSIAO AN）先生之间并不和睦。据说傅筱庵先生在掌权之初，曾有意更换部分科室主管，以终结某些弊端。据悉，由于遭到维新政府部分官员的反对或消极抵制，他至今未能如愿。/.

Objet: Activité des partisans du front populaire à
Shanghai.
No. 3143/S.
Référ: Articles pro-communistes chinois.
Propagande Japonaise.

Le journal japonais en langue chinoise "Sin Wen Pao"
a rapporté le 7 novembre 1938, que Mme HU HAI NI, née
YING (胡子嬰) était revenue à Shanghai et qu'elle
avait conféré avec M. KU CHENG (顧執中), Mlle CHIEN
KIEH CHIU (錢劍秋) etc. partisans du Front Populaire, pour
intensifier la propagande anti-japonaise à Shanghai.

De l'enquête que nous avons fait à la suite de la pu-
blication de cette information, il ressort que Mme HU
HAI NI qui a quitté Shanghai, après l'occupation de la
ville par les Japonais, n'a pas reparu. La nouvelle de son
arrivée de Hongkong est donc sans fondement.

M. KU CHENG fut l'un des dirigeants les plus ac-
tifs de la Fédération des différents milieux pour le Salut
National. Après l'occupation de Shanghai par les Japonais,
il se rendit dans le Sud. Revenu récemment dans notre ville,
il ne s'occupe que de la direction de l'école secondaire
"Ming Tse", Rue Paul Beau et de la Section des Renseigne-
ments du journal "Sin Wen Pao". Il ne se livre plus à au-
cune activité politique.

Mlle CHIEN KIEH CHIU, avocate, demeure au N°12, Sing
Ming Tsueng, Rue Brenier de Montmorand. Membre du Kuominta

日本宣传。

中文日文报纸《新闻报》（Sin Wen Pao）于1938年11月7日报道称，胡子婴（HU HAI NI， née YING）女士已返回上海，并与顾执中（KU CHENG）、钱剑秋（CHIEN KIEH CHIU）小姐等人民阵线支持者会晤，以加强在上海的反日宣传。

经我们在该消息发布后进行的调查，结果显示，胡子婴女士在日军占领上海后已离开，并未重现。因此，关于她从香港抵达的消息毫无根据。

顾执中（KU CHENG）先生曾是各界救国联合会最活跃的领导人之一。日军占领上海后，他前往南方。最近回到本市后，他仅负责贝当路（Rue Paul Beau）“明志”中学的管理工作以及《新闻报》情报部的工作。他不再从事任何政治活动。

Sin Shun Pao.

Activités des partisans du Front Populaire Chinois à
Shanghai.

Mme CHANG NAI CHI née HU TS . YING, militante du Front
Populaire Chinois, est arrivée récemment à Shanghai venant
de Hongkong.

Après avoir conféré avec Mlle CHIEN KIEN CHIU, avocat
de Shanghai et M. KU CHEN CHUNG, professeur de l'Ecole se-
condaire "Sin Min", rue Bourgeat, et rédacteur du journal
"Sin Wan Pao", elle a décidé en vue d'intensifier la pro-
pagande à Shanghai, de publier un magazine intitulé "Tuan
Chi" (Union) et d'autres brochures de propagande.

Elle déploie actuellement ses activités en vue d'obte-
nir les fonds nécessaires à ces publications.

中国人民阵线支持者在上海的活动。

中国人民阵线积极分子张乃炽（CHANG NAI CHI，音译），原名胡茨英（HU TS . YING，音译），近期从香港抵达上海。

在与上海律师钱剑秋（CHIEN KIEN CHIU，音译）先生及新民中学教师、《新晚报》（Sin Wan Pao）编辑顾震中（KU CHEN CHUNG，音译）先生会晤后，她决定出版一份名为《团结》（Tuan Chi）的杂志及其他宣传小册子，以加强在上海的宣传力度。

她目前正积极开展活动，以筹集出版所需资金。

For the purpose of strengthening the French Military
Defence Works in the Zikawei zone, the F.M.C. on September
28 had barbed-wire entanglements erected at Loh Ka Za,
between Avenue Haig and Hungjao Road.

At 3 a.m. the same day, about 60 or 70 French and
Annamite soldiers erected further barbed wire defences on
Hungjao Road near houses Nos. 670 and 650.

Further, F.M.C. labourers recently built a blockhouse
on a piece of waste ground near 650 Hungjao Road.

To the west of the Hungjao and Keswick Roads level
crossing (Japanese occupied zone), trenches have been
constructed by Japanese soldiers.

...........

Japanese soldiers are digging trenches at the limit
of the French Bund near Tung Mon Lou.

...........

At 1.20 p.m. 28/9/38, 20 Japanese gendarmes searched
the village of Lu Hsiah Za, Brenan Road for secretly stored
arms. Nothing found.

...........

The Kulangsu (Amoy) British authorities have requested
the S.M.C. to authorize the exportation of 3,000 bags of
Chinese rice which are urgently required for the needs of the
population. The Customs in Shanghai have given their approval
for the export. 350 bags are due to leave for Kulangsu on
30/9/38 on the B. & S. s.s. "Taiyuan."

----------

At 1 p.m. March 1, the Japanese telephoned the
"Chinese Scientific Press," 649 Avenue Foch and invited
the shroff to go to the Pei Kung Restaurant, Chekiang Road,
where he would be awaited. Wei Pao Seng, who speaks Japanese
went there immediately. At the restaurant the Japanese
invited him to go to Room 521, Hardoon Building, 233
Nanking Road. During the course of a conversation held there,
they asked him for information on the present status of the
company, receipts, expenses, etc. The interview finished at
4.45 p.m. and Wei returned to his shop.

It is to be recalled that the Chinese Scientific
Press was visited on February 25 by a Japanese in plain
clothes.

French Police Daily Report - March 3, 1938

General Teng Hsi Hou, commander of the 45th Army
(Szechunese troops), has been appointed, as from 1.3.38,
Pacification Commissioner of Szechuen and Sikang, replacing
General Liu Hsiang, deceased.

----------

At 12.40 p.m. yesterday, two plain clothes Japanese
entered 649 Avenue Foch, offices of the "Chinese Science
Corporation." They went up to the first floor and asked
to see the manager who was absent. One of the two visitors
was recognised as having been the man who carried out the
search of the same premises on 25.2.38.
The French Police arrived almost immediately and
made the two men leave. They made their way to the Settlement.
The management of the concern has now decided to
close down for some days.

----------

Two Japanese in civilian clothing proceeded at
2 p.m. yesterday to the Central Mint Godown, 9 Quai de
France, but withdrew when they saw the French Police on
guard.

----------

Mr. Orlando Pao, director of the Shanghai Telegraph
office left Shanghai yesterday for Fukien in the s.s.

of students by Chinese soldiers in Peking (1926), the

of the Chinese Republic." No meetings, however, will be
held.

Mr. Koo Sun Now, public-ricksha owner, intends to
create a "Chapei Peace Maintenance Autonomous Committee."
Parleys with the Japanese authorities are now being held.

Koo is the elder brother of Koo Tso Yuen, owner
of the Hien Chuan Theatre, Yunnan - Foochow Roads corner,
who was suspected of having assassinated Tang Kia Fung,
ex-chief of the Great World. He is now an adviser to the

Ta Tung Road, Chapei.

                                        80316/01
                            September 23, 1938.

Situation at the Marche de l'Est

    The arrivals of fresh fish or cold storage fish at the
Marche de l'Est are becoming less and less for the following
reasons :-
1) The boats transporting cold storage fish are frequently
   stopped by the Japanese military who divert them to the
   Yangtsepoo Fish Market.
2) The presence of pirates off Tinghai, the fishing region.
3) The Japanese navy has confiscated sixty fishing boats off
   Tinghai and destroyed the homes of about 40 fishermen. All
   other fishermen have taken to flight.
    The Association of Cold Storage Fish Hongs, No.123 Quai
de France, recently sent several representatives to the fishing
areas (Tinghai, Sengkiameng, etc.) to induce fishermen to send
their catches to Taichow or Ningpo where the fish will be packed
in barrels and from there the fish will be transported to
Shanghai by steamers flying foreign flags to avoid interference
by Japanese.

Miscellaneous

    At 12.20 a.m. September 22 anti-Kuomintang and anti-
communist circulars were distributed on Jessfield Road and
Kinnear Road. No arrests were made.

    At 2 p.m. yesterday five representatives of ricsha pullers
of the International Settlement called at the office of lawyer
Chen Ting Sui, Chairman of the Pullers' Mutual Aid Association,
131 Museum Road, to submit the following demands :-
1) That Chiu Tse Tung, Secretary-General of the Pullers' Mutual
   Aid Association, be dismissed.
2) That the accounts of the Association be published.
3) That a Supervisory Committee under the direction of the
   ricsha pullers themselves be organized.
    As there was nobody to receive them, the callers
withdrew.

                                        80316/01
                            1938年9月23日。

东市场情况

    由于以下原因，运抵东市场的鲜鱼或冷藏鱼越来越少：-
1) 运输冷藏鱼的船只经常被日军拦截，并被改道送往杨树浦鱼市场。
2) 捕鱼区定海附近出现海盗。
3) 日本海军在定海附近没收了六十艘渔船，并摧毁了约40名渔民的家。所有其他渔民均已逃散。
    位于法兰西外滩123号的冷藏鱼行公会最近派遣了几名代表前往捕鱼区（定海、沈家门等），劝说渔民将渔获运往台州或宁波，在那里将鱼装入桶中，然后通过悬挂外国旗帜的轮船运往上海，以避免日本的干扰。

杂项

    9月22日凌晨12时20分，极司菲尔路和金尼尔路上散发了反国民党和反共产主义的传单。未发生逮捕事件。

    昨日下午2时，国际租界的五名人力车夫代表拜访了位于博物馆路131号的互助会主席陈廷绥律师办公室，提出以下要求：-
1) 罢免互助会秘书长邱泽东。
2) 公布互助会账目。
3) 组建一个由人力车夫自己领导的监督委员会。
    由于无人接待，来访者离去。

（批注：是的，高，通话发生在9月20日。）

On September 14 the gunboat Saga and the destroyer Sagi
of the 11th Flotilla were noticed moving down the Yangtse River
with the aid of several tug boats. The two warships appear to
be damaged.
On September 19 a damaged destroyer of the Sagi type
arrived in Shanghai. She was towed to the Klangnan Dock by
several tug boats.

Situation at the Jih Loh Poo Fish Market

Owing to the seizure of fresh water fish by the Fish
Market at Yangtszepoo the arrivals of fresh water fish at Marche
de l'Est have practically ceased. About 400 hawkers are now
obtaining supplies from the Yangtszepoo Fish Market. At the
Marche de l'Est only cold storage fish and salted fish are
being dealt in. Trading has been reduced to a quarter.

Japanese and French Concession Ordure Removal

On September 17 eleven ordure boats instead of
discharging their loads at Pootung, dumped them into the Whangpoo
River near Lunghwa. The Japanese stopped the boats and
manhandled the crews and warned them that a repetition of
the offence they would be shot and their boats sunk in the
river. The boatmen were then allowed to go.

The Kwang Hwa University

Yesterday the management of the Kwang Hwa University
affixed a notice at No.95 Avenue Victor Emmanuel III announcing
that it has removed to No.422 Hankow Road.

1938年9月20日。

海军行动

9月14日，注意到第十一舰队的萨贺号炮艇和萨吉号驱逐舰在几艘拖船的协助下沿长江下行。这两艘军舰似乎受损。

日陆浦鱼市场情况

    由于杨树浦鱼市场截留淡水鱼，运抵东市场的淡水鱼几乎绝迹。目前约有400名摊贩从杨树浦鱼市场获取货源。在东市场，仅交易冷藏鱼和咸鱼。交易量已减少至四分之一。

日本人与法租界垃圾清运

光华大学

French Police Intelligence Report No. 3. B. 1
Sept. 21, 1938.

Naval Operations

On September 19 the damaged gunboat Saga was
towed to the Kiangnan Dock by several tug-boats.

Land Registration by Shanghai Municipal Administration

With the object of collecting a land tax, the
Land Bureau of the Shanghai Municipal Administration
on September 20 distributed notices in Zao Ka Dou
requesting land owners to register between September
20 and October 10. Registration is free of charge.
The following offices will undertake the
registration:-
1) 92 Jessfield Road.
2) Lai Ni Dou--Ching Chiu Road, Pootung.
3) In the former premises of the Fire Brigade
at Siao Nan Men (Nantao).
4) 20 Kwei Chao Road, Kiangwan.
5) At the Bureau of the Chief of the District
of Kaochiao, Pootung.

A Kuomintang Anniversary

The Chinese people to-day will hoist the
flag at half mast to commemorate the anniversary of
the assassination of Tsu Che Sing, a veteran Kuomintang
member, at Canton on September 21, 1920.

Labour Situation

On the ground of high cost of living, 40
messengers of the former Chinese Government Radio
Administration, Jinkee Road, at present under the
control of the Japanese, are demanding an increase
of pay.
The messengers of the Commercial Pacific
Cable Co., the Eastern Extension Telegraph Co. and
the Great Northern Telegraph Co., 34 Avenue Edward
VII, have presented a similar demand.

Chinese Police Bureau

To facilitate its work, the Police Bureau of
the Shanghai Municipal Administration in Pootung is
planning to transfer to the premises of the former
Tangpu near Ghisi Bridge, Nantao. Men have been
detailed to the place to make the necessary arrange-
ments.

                                September 12, 1938.

Naval Operations
    On the morning of September 10 the aircraft carrier Kamoi
was noticed at anchor off Woosung. It appears that she had been
damaged.
    At 11 a.m. September 11 the armed Japanese merchantmen
Mika Maru arrived in Shanghai in a damaged condition. She was
immediately towed to Kiangnan Dock by three tugs.

Appeal to League of Nations
    Twelve local Chinese public bodies, including the Chinese
Ratepayers' Association of the International Settlement, the
Chinese Chamber of Commerce, the Shanghai Civic Association, the
Citizens' Federation of the First Special District (International
Settlement), on September 10, sent through the Ministry of Foreign
Affairs, a telegram addressed to the League of Nations requesting
it to apply the clauses of Article 17 of the Covenant so that the
member nations might apply sanctions against Japan.

The Fish Market in Yangtszepoo
    100 fish hawkers are daily procuring supplies from the
Fish Market at the corner of Chemulpo Road and Yangtszepoo Road.
The daily sales total about $4,000. The fresh water fish placed
on sale at this market is part of the catches of fishing boats.
The cold storage fish is supplied by a Japanese sea products
company and by the "Company of Fishing Boats of East China"
formed by Japanese.
    The fish hawkers are taken to the market in two trucks
from the Garden Bridge free of charge. Since a few days ago a
transportation charge has been enforced of 30 cents per hawker
and 20 cents per basket of fish, to and from the market.

Labour Situation
    On September 10, thirteen workers of the Hwa Chen
Cigarette Factory were paid their discharge allowance at the
Chinese Industrial Bank, Nanking Road.
    From August 1 to September 10 about 2,500 workers have
been paid.
    The 1,300 workers who have returned to native places may,
when they return to Shanghai, call at any time at the office of
the factory at No.476 Ningpo Road.
    The Tseng Tai Rubber Goods Factory, No.3 Lane No.512 Dalny
Road, employing 300 male and female workers, suspended operations
on the outbreak of hostilities.
    With the permission of the Japanese authorities the
management has decided to re-open the factory immediately. About
50 workers were dispatched to the factory yesterday to undertake
repairs to the plant.
    The office of the factory is located at No.36 Rue de la
Mission.
    About 80 male and female hands are at present working at
No. 205 Shantung Road (first storey) making khaki raincoats for
the Japanese military authorities. The shop has no signboard.

                                1938年9月12日。

海军行动
    9月10日上午，有人注意到航空母舰“神威”号（Kamoi）停泊在吴淞口外。看来该舰已受损。
    9月11日上午11时，武装日本商船“美香丸”（Mika Maru，音译）受损抵达上海。随即由三艘拖船将其拖往江南造船厂码头。

向国际联盟呼吁
    包括公共租界华人纳税会、上海总商会、上海市民协会、第一特区（公共租界）公民联合会在内的十二个本地中国公共团体，于9月10日通过外交部向国际联盟发送了一份电报，请求其适用《盟约》第十七条的条款，以便成员国对日本实施制裁。

杨树浦鱼市场
    每天有100名鱼贩从 Chemulpo Road（音译，即仁川路）与杨树浦路拐角处的鱼市场采购货物。每日销售额总计约4,000元。在该市场出售的淡水鱼部分是渔船的捕获物。冷藏鱼则由一家日本海产品公司和由日本人组建的“华东渔船公司”供应。
    鱼贩们由两辆卡车免费从外白渡桥运送到市场。几天前开始，强制执行往返市场的交通费，每名鱼贩30分，每筐鱼20分。

劳工状况
    9月10日，华成香烟厂的十三名工人在南京路的中国工业银行领取了遣散费。
    从8月1日至9月10日，约有2,500名工人已领到款项。
    已返回原籍的1,300名工人，回到上海后，可随时前往宁波路476号的工厂办公室。
    大连路512弄3号的曾泰橡胶制品厂（Tseng Tai Rubber Goods Factory，音译），雇佣男女工人300名，在战事爆发时停工。
    经日本当局许可，管理层决定立即重新开工。昨天已派遣约50名工人到工厂进行设备维修。
    工厂办公室位于 Mission Road（音译，即传教士路）36号。
    目前约有80名男女工人在山东路205号（二楼）为日本军方制作卡其布雨衣。该店铺没有招牌。

French Police Intelligence Report
----------------------------------
No. 7 B    X031210
September 14, 1938.

Bombs Thrown into a Customs Brokerage Hong on Rue du Consulat

At about 12.30 p.m. yesterday three unknown persons called at the Yung Sheng Tai Customs Brokerage Hong, House No. 10, Lane No 183, Rue du Consulat. One of them threw two grenades one of which exploded wounding two employees. The three men made good their escape after leaving behind several printed papers a translation of which follows:
"Execution of Hu Tsing Ching and other traitors of the Yung Sheng Tai Hong who are supplying provisions to the enemy.
"Executed by the Anti-Japanese Group of the Chinese Race Charged with the Extermination of Traitors."
The Yung Sheng Tai, the manager of which is Hu Tsing Ching residing at No. 1C, Lane No. 120, Rue Bourgeat, has since May, 1938 exported on behalf of its clients about 150,000 bags of flour to Tientsin, a city under Japanese occupation. About a month ago, the hong received a threatening letter signed "Anti-Japanese Group of the Chinese Race Charged with the Extermination of Traitors." The threat was not taken seriously for the shop suspended the exportation for a few days only.
An investigation has revealed that of the 99 Customs brokerage hongs in the French Concession 18 are engaged in the exportation of cereals to North China, including the hong that was attacked yesterday.

Situation at the Yangtszepoo Fish Market

We reported on September 6 that the Fish Market in Yangtszepoo had adopted a new method of business which consisted of dividing the fish in lots and then selling to the highest bidder. As this method was found to be harmful to the business of the market, it has been abandoned. The value of the lots was often beyond the purse of the hawkers.
Business is now being conducted as at the beginning. Hawkers may make purchases from $1 upward.
On the other hand, the market which at the beginning had promised not to charge the hawkers any commission is now collecting a commission of 1.5%. The commission charged at the Jih Loh Poo Market is 3%.

Chinese Chamber of Commerce and Revenue Stamps

Revenue stamps used to be sold in Shanghai through the branches of the Post Office. When the Reformed Government and the Japanese authorities interfered, the Director of Posts of Kiangsu, Chekiang and Anhwei on June 15 ordered the branches to cease selling the revenue stamps of the National Government.
To remedy the situation, Wang Hsiao Lai, Chairman of the Shanghai Chinese Chamber of Commerce, who is at present at Hongkong, has sent to Shanghai a large quantity of revenue stamps which are being sold at the temporary office of the Chamber at No.59 Hongkong Road. Large numbers of people have bought these stamps.
It should be noted that the affixing of revenue stamps is at present optional in Shanghai.
pages.zh:
法国警察情报报告
----------------------------------
编号 7 B    X031210
1938年9月14日。

向领事馆路的一家报关行投掷炸弹

昨天中午12时30分左右，三名不明身份者来到领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）183弄10号的永盛泰（Yung Sheng Tai，音译）报关行。其中一人投掷了两枚手榴弹，其中一枚爆炸，炸伤两名雇员。这三人在留下几份印刷品后成功逃脱，译文如下：
“处决永盛泰行的胡清卿（Hu Tsing Ching，音译）及其他向敌人提供补给的汉奸。
“由负责肃清汉奸的中华民族抗日团执行。”
永盛泰的经理胡清卿居住在 Bourgeat Road（音译）120弄1C号，自1938年5月以来，该行代表客户向被日本占领的城市天津出口了约15万袋面粉。大约一个月前，该行收到一封署名为“负责肃清汉奸的中华民族抗日团”的恐吓信。由于该店仅暂停出口几天，威胁未被认真对待。
调查显示，在法租界的99家报关行中，有18家从事向华北出口谷物的业务，其中包括昨天遭到袭击的那家报关行。

杨树浦鱼市场的情况

我们在9月6日报告中提到，杨树浦鱼市场采用了一种新的经营方法，即将鱼分成批次，然后出价最高者得。由于发现这种方法损害了市场的生意，该方法已被放弃。批次的价值往往超出了鱼贩的承受能力。
现在的业务方式已恢复到最初的状态。鱼贩可以购买1元以上的货物。
另一方面，市场起初承诺不向鱼贩收取佣金，但现在收取1.5%的佣金。日洛浦（Jih Loh Poo，音译）市场收取的佣金为3%。

上海总商会与印花税票

印花税票过去在上海通过邮局分支机构销售。当维新政府和日本当局进行干涉时，江苏、浙江和安徽邮政局长于6月15日命令各分支机构停止销售国民政府的印花税票。
为了补救这一情况，目前身处香港的上海总商会主席王晓籁（Wang Hsiao Lai，音译）向上海发送了大量印花税票，这些税票正在香港路59号的商会临时办公室出售。许多人购买了这些税票。
需要注意的是，目前在上海贴用印花税票是自愿的。

September 13, 1938.

Gifts to National Government and Refugees

On the occasion of the 7th Anniversary of the Mukden Incident (September 18), various public bodies have decided to start a movement to present gifts to the National Government and local refugees.
Gifts in the form of money, jewellery, gold etc. to the National Government may be sent to the Central Bank of China, the Bank of China and the Bank of Communications.
Gifts for refugees may be sent to the International Relief Committee, the Red Swastika Society, the Federation of Charity Organizations, etc. Used garments may also be sent.
No organization is undertaking the collection of cotton padded vests for soldiers because of difficulties of transportation to the front.

Situation on Extra-Settlement Area Roads

At 6 a.m. September 12, two night shift workers named Yang King Fah and Chuan Ling of the Toa Seime Kaisha, 64 Robison Road, who were in possession of two circulars of the "People's Group for National Salvation" to commemorate the anniversary of the Mukden Incident, were arrested by Japanese gendarmes on a denunciation made by the private watchman of the company. They were taken to the Japanese Gendarmerie post on Kinnear Road for interrogation.

Refugee Relief

Certain tenants of Bourgogne Lane, Passage 589, Avenue du Roi Albert, had affixed a box to the entrance of the lane for the reception of gifts for refugees. The box was eventually removed on our orders.

Mr. Yu Ya Ching, Chinese member of the Shanghai Municipal Council, Mr. Feng Lan Ting, a well known local philanthropist, and others are organizing theatrical performances for the benefit of refugees. The proceeds from the sale of tickets will be used for the purchase of clothing for refugees.
A meeting of the Preparatory Committee was held at the Ningpo Fellow Provincials Association, No.480 Yu Ya Ching Road, yesterday at which were present some 20 persons.
It was resolved that Mr. Yu Ya Ching and Mr. Feng Lan Ting be appointed to take charge of the arrangements.

Fish Hawkers Form Body

On August 24 we reported that fish hawkers were planning to form a "Mutual Society of Fish Hawkers of Shanghai." A preparatory meeting was held at 2 p.m. September 12 at the Tai Chong building on Chekiang Road. About 40 persons were present. Chu Ting Fa presided.
The following resolutions were passed :-
(1) The object of the Society is to protect the interests of the hawkers and to help members who are in misery.
(2) No fees will be collected. The expenses will be defrayed by a subsidy from the Association of Fish Hong Owners.
(3) The Correspondence Office will be established in the building of the Association of Cold Storage Fish Hong Owners at No.123 Quai de France.

1938年9月13日。

向国民政府及难民捐赠礼品

值此“九一八”事变七周年（9月18日）之际，各公共团体决定发起一项运动，向国民政府及本地难民赠送礼品。
向国民政府捐赠的现金、珠宝、黄金等礼品，可送至中国银行、交通银行及中央银行。
供难民使用的礼品可送至国际救济委员会、世界红卍字会、慈善团体联合会等。旧衣物亦可送交。
由于运往前线存在困难，目前没有任何组织负责收集供士兵使用的棉背心。

越界筑路地区局势

9月12日上午6时，罗宾森路64号东亚制面会社（Toa Seime Kaisha）的两名夜班工人杨金发（Yang King Fah，音译）和传灵（Chuan Ling，音译），因持有两份纪念“九一八”事变的“救国团”传单，被该公司私人巡捕告发后，由日本宪兵逮捕。他们被带至金尼尔路（Kinnear Road，音译）的日本宪兵哨所进行审讯。

难民救济

阿尔贝特国王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）589弄勃艮第里（Bourgogne Lane）的部分租户在弄堂入口处放置了一个箱子，用于接收捐赠给难民的物品。该箱子最终奉我方命令被移除。

上海工部局华董俞亚清先生、本地著名慈善家冯兰亭先生等人正在组织义演，以资助难民。售票所得将用于为难民购买衣物。
筹备委员会会议于昨日在虞洽卿路480号宁波同乡会举行，约有20人出席。
会议决议任命俞亚清先生和冯兰亭先生负责安排事宜。

鱼贩组建团体

我们在8月24日曾报告称，鱼贩计划组建“上海鱼贩互助社”。9月12日下午2时，在浙江路泰崇大楼举行了一次筹备会议。约有40人出席。朱廷发（Chu Ting Fa，音译）担任主席。
通过以下决议：
(1) 本社宗旨为保护小贩利益，并援助陷入困境的社员。
(2) 不收取任何费用。开支由鱼行业主协会提供补贴支付。
(3) 通讯处设在法租界外滩123号冷藏鱼行业主协会大楼内。

French Police Intelligence Report

September 10, 1938.

Japanese Visit A Cigarette Factory in French Concession

The Kiang Che Cigarette Factory, 89-91 Rue Bluntschili, was established 12 years ago. It employs 20 male and 120 female hands. It is at present being operated on behalf of the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Company.
At 2.30 p.m. yesterday two Japanese in civilian dress visited the factory. Presenting a visiting card of the "Tah Chung Reform Society," the Japanese asked to see the manager, Mr. King Yung Ching. Upon being informed that he was out, the Japanese withdrew, declaring that they would call again on the morning of September 10.
A discreet watch is being maintained at the factory.

Two Hardware Stores in French Concession Receive Threatening Letters

The Yi Yuen Copper and Tin Shop, No.214 Rue du Consulat, and the San Hop Copper and Tin Shop, No.409 Boulevard des Deux Republiques, have for some time been selling large quantities of copper and tin to Japanese and have made huge profits.
Yesterday each of the two shops received a letter from a patriotic body enjoining them to cease these transactions immediately under pain of severe sanctions.

Threatening Letter Received by Mr. Gould of "Evening Post and Mercury"

Mr. Gould, Editor-in-Chief of the American newspaper "Evening Post and Mercury," who has returned to Shanghai from a two weeks' holiday in Japan, has received a threatening letter signed "Kung Tseng" (Justice"). It read :-
"Dear Mr. Gould,
I hear that you have received a huge subsidy from the Japanese Government, the amount of which is unknown. If it is true, the 'Ta Mei Pao' will soon find its circulation diminishing.
I do not know why you have acted in this way. I hope you will give a reply in your paper.
Kung Tseng,
September 9"
In yesterday's edition of the "Ta Mei Wan Pao," Mr. Gould published a note that the rumour of a subsidy from the Japanese Government is groundless. He added that his newspaper was completely independent and its object is purely commercial.

Situation at Marche de l'Est

During the past few days the arrivals of cold storage fish and fresh water fish at Marche de l'Est have considerably diminished. The following are believed to be the causes :-
1) The period of the greatest fishing activity has already passed.
2) Japanese warships frequently appear off Tinghai (Chusan) and fire upon fishing boats so that fishermen are now afraid to proceed to sea.
3) The fresh water fish destined for the Marche de l'Est is often detained by the Japanese who send it to the fish market of the "Reformed Government" in Yangtsepu.

1938年9月10日。

日本人访问法租界一家卷烟厂

位于布伦茨希利路（Rue Bluntschili，音译）89-91号的江浙卷烟厂成立于12年前。雇佣男工20名，女工120名。目前代南洋兄弟烟草公司经营。
昨日下午2时30分，两名便衣日本人访问了该厂。日本人出示“大中革新社”的名片，要求见经理金永庆（King Yung Ching，音译）先生。得知其外出后，日本人离去，声称将于9月10日上午再次来访。
目前正对该厂保持秘密监视。

法租界两家五金店收到恐吓信

领事馆路214号怡源铜锡店和两共和国大道409号三合铜锡店长期以来向日本人出售大量铜锡，获利丰厚。
昨日，这两家店各收到一封来自爱国团体的信件，勒令其立即停止此类交易，否则将面临严厉制裁。

《大美晚报》古尔德先生收到恐吓信

美国报纸《大美晚报》（Evening Post and Mercury）主编古尔德（Gould）先生从日本度假两周后返回上海，收到一封署名为“公正”（Justice）的恐吓信。内容如下：
“亲爱的古尔德先生：
听说你接受了日本政府的大笔津贴，金额不详。如果属实，‘大美报’的发行量很快就会减少。
我不知道你为何这样做。希望你在报上给予答复。
公正，
9月9日”
在昨日的《大美晚报》上，古尔德先生刊登了一则声明，称接受日本政府津贴的谣言毫无根据。他补充说，他的报纸完全独立，其目的纯粹是商业性的。

东市场局势

过去几天，东市场（Marche de l'Est）的冷藏鱼和淡水鱼到货量大幅减少。据信原因如下：
1) 捕鱼最繁忙的季节已经过去。
2) 日本军舰频繁出现在定海（舟山）附近海域，并向渔船开火，导致渔民现在不敢出海。
3) 运往东市场的淡水鱼常被日本人扣留，并送往杨树浦的“维新政府”鱼市。

French Police Intelligence Report
September 6, 1938.

Shun Pao to Resume Publication Soon

The newspaper Shun Pao, 309 Hankow Road, ceased publication on December 15, 1937 because of the Japanese censorship. Since then it was published at Hongkong where it enjoyed a limited circulation. The management has now decided to resume publication in Shanghai on September 18, the anniversary of the Mukden Incident. If the arrangements cannot be made in time, publication will take place on October 10, the Double Tenth Festival.
Following the example of the "Sin Wan Pao" which since September 1 has been taken over by the Pacific Publishing Company, an American concern, the Shun Pao will also be published under the name of an American citizen. The matter is in the hands of an American lawyer named G. Allman, a Director of Colton Y.C. Co., No.239 Park Road. An agreement is under preparation.

The Police Bureau of the Shanghai Municipal Administration

Lu Ying, Chief of the Police Bureau of the Shanghai Municipal Administration, has detailed a number of his detectives to investigate anti-Japanese activities and into all political affairs in the Foreign Settlements.

Re-organization of the Fish Market in Yangtszepoo

Because of bad business, the new Fish Market at the corner of Yangtszepoo Road and Chemulpo Road has been re-organized and transformed into a kind of stock exchange. The goods are divided into lots and sold to the highest bidder.

Situation in the French Military Zone at Zi Ka Wei

In connection with the affair of Shu Teh Fang, Passage 2210, Avenue Haig (in the Zone) (see report of September 2, 1938) Chang Yun Long, the proprietor, has not, so far, come to a decision. However, on September 4 he collected from the tenants the rent for July 1938.

Situation in the Extra-Settlement Areas

At about 4 p.m. September 5 two Japanese in civil dress on buses No.10 and No.7 distributed anti-communist circulars of the Ta Ming Hui Association ("The Great People's Association") on Connaught Road, at Zao Ka Tu and at Brenan Place.

The Situation in Nantao

At about 8.15 p.m. September 4, twenty Japanese soldiers accompanied by 30 policemen of the Police Bureau of the Shanghai Municipal Administration carried out a search of Yuen Shing Fang, Nan Mow Der. They arrested 13 Chinese young men whom they regarded as guerrillas and took them to the Section of the Gendarmerie at Nantao for interrogation.

法国警务情报报告
1938年9月6日。

《申报》即将复刊

位于汉口路309号的《申报》因日本审查于1937年12月15日停刊。此后该报在香港出版，发行量有限。管理层现决定于9月18日“九一八”事变纪念日在上海复刊。若安排无法及时完成，则将于10月10日双十节出版。
效仿自9月1日起由美国企业太平洋出版公司接管的《新闻报》，《申报》也将以一名美国公民的名义出版。此事正由一位名为G. Allman的美国律师处理，他是帕克路239号Colton Y.C.公司的董事。协议正在起草中。

上海特别市政府警察局

上海特别市政府警察局局长卢英已派遣多名侦探调查租界内的反日活动及所有政治事务。

杨树浦鱼市重组

由于生意不佳，位于杨树浦路与济木浦路（Chemulpo Road）转角处的新鱼市已进行重组，转变为一种交易所性质的场所。货物被分成批次，出价最高者得。

徐家汇法军防区局势

关于海格路2210弄（位于防区内）舒德芳一案（参见1938年9月2日报告），业主张云龙（Chang Yun Long，音译）迄今尚未做出决定。然而，9月4日他向租户收取了1938年7月的租金。

越界筑路区域局势

9月5日下午4时许，两名身着便服的日本人在10路和7路公交车上，在康纳路（Connaught Road）、曹家渡（Zao Ka Tu，音译）及布伦南里（Brenan Place，音译）分发大明会（“Great People's Association”）的反共传单。

南市局势

9月4日晚8时15分许，20名日本士兵 accompanied by 30名上海特别市政府警察局警察，对南码头元盛坊进行了搜查。他们逮捕了13名被视为游击队的中国青年，并将其带往南市宪兵队分部进行审讯。

Opposition to Increase of Rent

Tao Teh Li (Passage 23), Avenue Foch (French side) has
86 houses of which 26 are on the road. The monthly rent of the
houses in the alleyway ranges from $52 to $53 and of the houses
on the road $56 to $58.
As the water charges, which are borne by the firm of
Benjamin and Sons, 259 Kiangse Road, the owners of the buildings,
having increased considerably, the company on September 2 notified
the tenants that from this month the rent of the houses on the
road will be increased by $13 a month and of those in the alleyway
$8.
The tenants opposed the increase and requested the
owners to reduce the increase by 50%. Failing to secure
satisfaction, they have retained lawyer Chen Mow Hsuan to open
negotiations with the firm.

Boppe Terrace (Passage 30), Avenue Dubail, has 78 houses,
of which 8 face the street. The rent of the houses in the alleyway
is $50 and of those facing the street, $58. The water charges
are borne by the Sai Shing Land Company, 152 Boppe Terrace, the
owners of the property. As the water charges and the land tax
have been considerably increased, the company on September 1
notified the tenants that the rent will be increased by $10 from
October 1.
The tenants have not yet revealed their attitude but
one Chow King Tsai, tenant of house No.136, is strongly opposing
the increase. He is planning to organize a Tenants' Association
to open negotiations with the landlord. He notified his
neighbours of his intention on September 3.

We have made several reports of the dispute between
tenants of Yih An Li (Passage 500), Avenue du Roi Albert, and
the firm of Marcel Darre, the manager of the property, over an
increase of rent.
The tenants are regularly paying the usual rent. Others
who are affected by the increase have handed their rent to the
Second Special District Court. They have retained Chiu Han Ping
to settle the dispute through the Courts.

Refugee Relief

The management of the Second Camp of the International
Relief Committee administered by the Salvation Army, Route de
Sieyes, has decided to establish work section in the camp for
refugees who have a profession.
Refugees who find work outside the camp will have to
hand to the management 30% of their daily earnings.

Labour Movement

Chen Kuo Liang, Chen Mow Yung and Chiu Ying Lung, so-
called representatives of ricsha pullers, called at the office
of the San Peh Steamship Company, 93 Canton Road, and also at
the Ming Shao Shipping Company, No.86 Ningpo Road, to see Mr.
Yu Ya Ching and Mr. Yuan Li-tung, Chinese members of the S.M.C.,
to solicit their assistance in bringing about a re-organization
of the Pullers' Mutual Aid Association and that the Association
be henceforth administered by the pullers themselves.
Mr. Yu and Mr. Yuan did not receive the callers.

36 workers of the Hwa Chen Tobacco Factory yesterday
received their discharge bonus at the Chinese Industrial Bank,
Nanking Road.

( 第2页 )

反对加租

法租界霞飞路陶德里（23弄）共有房屋86幢，其中26幢临街。弄堂内房屋的月租金为52至53美元，临街房屋为56至58美元。
由于由业主、江西路259号Benjamin and Sons公司承担的水费大幅增加，该公司于9月2日通知租户，从本月起，临街房屋月租金增加13美元，弄堂内房屋增加8美元。
租户反对加租，并要求业主将增幅减少50%。在未获满意答复后，他们聘请了律师陈茂轩（Chen Mow Hsuan，音译）与该公司展开谈判。

杜美路博佩露台（30弄）共有房屋78幢，其中8幢临街。弄堂内房屋租金为50美元，临街房屋为58美元。水费由物业业主、博佩露台152号赛兴地产公司（Sai Shing Land Company，音译）承担。由于水费和地税大幅增加，该公司于9月1日通知租户，自10月1日起租金增加10美元。
租户尚未表明态度，但136号租户周金才（Chow King Tsai，音译）强烈反对加租。他正计划组织租户协会与房东进行谈判。他于9月3日将此意图通知了邻居。

我们就阿尔贝特国王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）怡安里（500弄）租户与物业经理Marcel Darre公司之间因加租引发的纠纷已多次报告。
部分租户照常缴纳原定租金。其他受加租影响的租户已将租金交至第二特区法院。他们聘请了邱汉平（Chiu Han Ping，音译）通过法院解决纠纷。

难民救济

由救世军管理的西爱咸斯路国际救济委员会第二难民营管理处决定，在难民营内为有职业的难民设立工作部门。
在难民营外找到工作的难民，须将其每日收入的30%上交管理处。

劳工运动

所谓的人力车夫代表陈国良（Chen Kuo Liang，音译）、陈茂荣（Chen Mow Yung，音译）和邱应龙（Chiu Ying Lung，音译），前往广东路93号三北轮船公司办公室，以及宁波路86号明绍轮船公司，拜访工部局华董俞亚清先生和袁履登先生，请求他们协助改组车夫互助会，并使该会此后由车夫自行管理。
俞先生和袁先生未接见来访者。

华成烟草厂的36名工人昨日在南京路中国工业银行领取了遣散费。

Incident on Night Soil Jetty on Route Zikawei

Despite the negotiations by the contractor Chang
Chien Seng, the Japanese sentries near Zia Tu Road bridge,
opposite the night soil jetty of Route de Zikawei, are continuing
to arrest the crew of night soil boats who go ashore in the
French Concession to obtain payment for the removal of night
soil.
At 4.30 p.m. yesterday four boatmen were arrested
by the Japanese. They were released after having been severely
manhandled.
The boatmen are now afraid to enter the Zafekang Creek.

September 7, 1938.

Situation in Nantao

By order of Loo Ying, Chief of the Police Bureau of the Shanghai Municipal Administration, 300 policemen of Nantao were transferred to Chwansha, Pootung, on September 6. They will take part in fighting between Japanese soldiers and guerrillas who have been very active during the past few days.

Labour Movement

We have already reported on the activities of Chen Kuo Liang, Pi Chang Fah, etc., so-called representatives of ricsha pullers who have organized an "Association of Ricsha Pullers to Study Measures of Defence" and who are seeking to seize control of the Pullers' Mutual Aid Association.
To obstruct these intrigues, the Pullers' Mutual Aid Association has decided to engage pullers to conduct a campaign against them, such as by sending petitions to the S.M.C. and to the Chinese Ratepayers' Association of the International Settlement requesting them not to recognize Chen Kuo Liang and others as "representatives of the pullers."

27 workers of the Hwa Chen Cigarette Factory were paid their discharge allowance at the Chinese Industrial Bank on Nanking Road.

Refugee Relief

                                                fc 371 c
                                        September 8, 1938
General Situation

    At about 6 a.m. September 7 two workers named Huang Ah Moh
and Chen Sie Shih Tse of the Japan-China Spinning and Weaving
Company, 502 Robison Road, had an altercation with the private
watchman of the mill who wanted to search them. Upon being
informed, six Japanese gendarmes proceeded to the place in
military truck licence No.296 and placed the two men under arrest.
The gendarmes later took the two workers to the Japanese
Gendarmerie at No.92 Jessfield Road.

    At about 7.40 a.m. a hawker named Wang Pah Hwa, carrying a
load of vegetables, came from the Japanese defence zone and crossed
the Brenan Road bridge to enter the International Settlement. Two
Japanese soldiers pursued him although he was in the British
defence zone. A discussion here took place between the British
and Japanese soldiers for the latter desired to remove the hawker
to their sector.
    Upon a British officer intervening, the two Japanese withdrew
and the Chinese was set free.

Situation in Nantao

    Owing to the approach of the Mukden Incident on September 18,
any inhabitant of Nantao desiring to enter or leave Postang has
been required since September 7 to carry a good citizens certificate
and an anti-cholera vaccination certificate. On September 7 a
number of tatooed persons were arrested in Nantao by Japanese
soldiers and were released after having been manhandled by the
soldiers.

Labour Situation.

    The former messengers of the Telegraph Administration of the
Ministry of Communications and of the Chinese Government Radio
Administration have established a "Cyclist Service" in the porter's
hall of the Tanyang Secondary Girls' School in Lane No.1, House
No.210, Kaifeng Road. It has 20 members.
    Business firms who desire the service of the cyclists should
communicate with that address. The fee is 15 cents an hour.

    15 workers of the Hwa Chen Cigarette Factory yesterday
received their discharge allowance at the Chinese Industrial
Bank on Nanking Road.

总体局势

    9月7日上午6时许，罗宾森路（Robison Road）502号日华纺织株式会社的两名工人黄阿毛（Huang Ah Moh，音译）和陈锡士泽（Chen Sie Shih Tse，音译）与欲搜查他们的工厂私人看守发生争执。接到通知后，六名日本宪兵乘坐牌照号为296的军用卡车赶到现场，将两人逮捕。随后，宪兵将这两名工人带至极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）92号的日本宪兵队。

    上午7时40分许，一名名叫王八花（Wang Pah Hwa，音译）的小贩挑着蔬菜担子，从日军防区出来，穿过白利南路（Brenan Road）桥进入公共租界。两名日本士兵追赶他，尽管当时他已处于英军防区内。英日士兵之间随即发生争论，因为日方欲将该小贩带至其防区。
    经一名英国军官干预，两名日本士兵撤退，该中国人被释放。

南市局势

    鉴于9月18日“九一八”事变纪念日临近，自9月7日起，任何希望进出普陀（Postang，音译）的南市居民均须携带良民证和霍乱疫苗接种证。9月7日，多名身有纹身者在南市被日本士兵逮捕，并在遭受士兵殴打后被释放。

MUNICIPAL BULLETIN OF SEPTEMBER 1, 1938

No. 304 Consular Ordinance
August 25, 1938

We, Pierre Auge, Acting Consul-General for France
at Shanghai, Chevalier of the Legion of Honour, Medaille
Militaire and Croix de Guerre,

By virtue of Article XIII of the Regulations of
the Municipal Organization of the French Concession at
Shanghai dated January 15, 1927,

Have ordered and do order as follows:-

Article 1 - The sidewalk in front of each house
must be constantly kept clear for traffic and maintained in
a state of cleanliness. All articles liable to obstruct or
endanger traffic especially rubbish dropped by passers-by
and packing materials, must be removed as soon as they are
noticed. The sidewalk must be washed at least once a day.
The washing of the gutter with plenty of water once
a day is compulsory.

Article 2 - The head of a family living on the ground
floor of a building is responsible for the observance of the
stipulations contained in Article 1. If the ground floor
is occupied by several families, the various heads of families
will be held jointly responsible.

Article 3 - The washing of the sidewalks is not
necessary during frost. The sidewalk should be sprinkled
with sand or ash.

Article 4 - Breaches of the stipulations of the
preceding Articles will be dealt with as follows: first
offence, by a warning; second offence, by a second and final
warning; for other offences, a fine of from $1 to $10 will be
imposed. The fine may be doubled in case of a repetition
of the offence.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 8039 A/10
September 6, 1938. 35
Date

Shun Pao to Resume Publication Soon

The newspaper Shun Pao, 309 Hankow Road, ceased publication on December 15, 1937 because of the Japanese censorship. Since then it was published at Hongkong where it enjoyed a limited circulation. The management has now decided to resume publication in Shanghai on September 18, the anniversary of the Mukden Incident. If the arrangements cannot be made in time, publication will take place on October 10, the Double Tenth Festival.

Following the example of the "Sin Wan Pao" which since September 1 has been taken over by the Pacific Publishing Company, an American concern, the Shun Pao will also be published under the name of an American citizen. The matter is in the hands of an American lawyer named G. Allman, a Director of Colton Y.C. Co., No.239 Park Road. An agreement is under preparation.

The Police Bureau of the Shanghai Municipal Administration

Lu Ying, Chief of the Police Bureau of the Shanghai Municipal Administration, has detailed a number of his detectives to investigate anti-Japanese activities and into all political affairs in the Foreign Settlements.

Re-organization of the Fish Market in Yangtszepoo

Because of bad business, the new Fish Market at the corner of Yangtszepoo Road and Chaulipo Road has been re-organized and transformed into a kind of stock exchange. The goods are divided into lots and sold to the highest bidder.

Situation in the French Military Zone at Zi Ka Wei

In connection with the affair of Sin Teh Fang, Passage 2210, Avenue Haig (in the Zone) (see report of September 2, 1938) Chang Yun Long, the proprietor, has not, so far, come to a decision. However, on September 4 he collected from the tenants the rent for July 1938.

Situation in the Extra-Settlement Areas

At about 4 p.m. September 5 two Japanese in civil dress on buses No.10 and No.7 distributed anti-communist circulars of the Ta Ming Hui Association ("The Great People's Association") on Connaught Road, at Zao Ka Tu and at Bremen Place.

The Situation in Nantao

At about 8.15 p.m. September 4, twenty Japanese soldiers accompanied by 30 policemen of the Police Bureau of the Shanghai Municipal Administration carried out a search of Yuan Shing Fang, San Kew Bar. They arrested 13 Chinese young men whom they regarded as guerrillas and took them to the Section of the Gendarmerie at Nantao for interrogation.

《申报》即将复刊

位于汉口路309号的《申报》因日本审查于1937年12月15日停刊。此后该报在香港出版，发行量有限。管理层现已决定于9月18日“九一八”事变纪念日在上海复刊。若安排无法及时完成，则将于10月10日双十节出版。

效仿自9月1日起由美国企业太平洋出版公司接管的《新闻报》，《申报》也将以一名美国公民的名义出版。此事正由一位名为 G. Allman 的美国律师处理，他是派克路239号 Colton Y.C. 公司的董事。协议正在起草中。

上海特别市政府警察局

上海特别市政府警察局局长卢英已派遣多名侦探调查反日活动及公共租界内的所有政治事务。

杨树浦鱼市重组

由于生意不佳，位于杨树浦路与周家嘴路转角处的新鱼市已进行重组，转变为一种交易所形式。货物被分成批次，出价最高者得。

徐家汇法军防区局势

关于海格路2210弄（位于防区内）新德坊一事（参见1938年9月2日报告），业主张云龙（Chang Yun Long，音译）迄今尚未做出决定。然而，9月4日他向租户收取了1938年7月的租金。

越界筑路区域局势

9月5日下午4时许，两名身着便服的日本人在10路和7路公交车上，在康纳路、曹家渡及 Bremen Place（音译）分发大明会（“Great People's Association”）的反共传单。

南市局势

9月4日晚8时15分左右，20名日本士兵在上海特别市政府警察局30名警察的陪同下，搜查了三官堂桥元兴坊。他们逮捕了13名被视为游击队的中国青年，并将其带往南市宪兵队分部进行审讯。

( Page 2 )

Opposition to Increase of Rent

Tao Teh Li (Passage 23), Avenue Foch (French side) has
86 houses of which 26 are on the road. The monthly rent of the
houses in the alleyway ranges from $22 to $53 and of the houses
on the road $66 to $88.
As the water charges, which are borne by the firm of
Benjamin and Sons, 289 Kiangse Road, the owners of the buildings,
having increased considerably, the company on September 2 notified
the tenants that from this month the rent of the houses on the
road will be increased by $13 a month and of those in the alleyway
$8.
The tenants opposed the increase and requested the
owners to reduce the increase by 50%. Failing to secure
satisfaction, they have retained lawyer Chen New Hsuan to open
negotiations with the firm.

Beppe Terrace (Passage 30), Avenue Dubail, has 78 houses,
of which 8 face the street. The rent of the houses in the alleyway
is $30 and of those facing the street, $88. The water charges
are borne by the Sai Shing Land Company, 182 Beppe Terrace, the
owners of the property. As the water charges and the land tax
have been considerably increased, the company on September 1
notified the tenants that the rent will be increased by $10 from
October 1.
The tenants have not yet revealed their attitude but
one Chew King Tsai, tenant of house No.136, is strongly opposing
the increase. He is planning to organize a Tenants' Association
to open negotiations with the landlord. He notified his
neighbours of his intention on September 3.

We have made several reports of the dispute between
tenants of Yih An Li (Passage 800), Avenue du Roi Albert, and
the firm of Marcel Darre, the manager of the property, over an
increase of rent.
The tenants are regularly paying the usual rent. Others
who are affected by the increase have handed their rent to the
Second Special District Court. They have retained Chiu Han Ping
to settle the dispute through the Courts.

Refugee Relief

The management of the Second Camp of the International
Relief Committee administered by the Salvation Army, Route de
Sicawei, has decided to establish work sections in the camp for
refugees who have a profession.
Refugees who find work outside the camp will have to
hand to the management 30% of their daily earnings.

Labour Movement

Chen Kuo Liang, Chen Mow Yung and Chin Ying Lung, so-
called representatives of ricksha pullers, called at the office
of the San Peh Steamship Company, 98 Canton Road, and also at
the King Hwa Shipping Company, No.86 Ningpo Road, to see Mr.
Yu Ya Ching and Mr. Yuan Li-tung, Chinese members of the S.M.C.,
to solicit their assistance in bringing about a re-organization
of the Pullers' Mutual Aid Association and that the Association
be henceforth administered by the pullers themselves.
Mr. Yu and Mr. Yuan did not receive the callers.

36 workers of the Hwa Chen Tobacco Factory yesterday
received their discharge bonus at the Chinese Industrial Bank,
Nanking Road.

( 第2页 )

反对增加租金

法租界霞飞路陶德里（23弄）共有房屋86幢，其中26幢临街。弄堂内房屋的月租金为22至53美元，临街房屋为66至88美元。
由于由建筑物所有者、江西路289号 Benjamin and Sons 公司承担的水费大幅增加，该公司于9月2日通知租户，从本月起，临街房屋每月租金增加13美元，弄堂内房屋增加8美元。
租户反对涨价，并要求业主将增幅减少50%。在未获满意答复后，他们聘请了陈新轩律师（Chen New Hsuan，音译）与该公司进行谈判。

杜美路贝佩台（30弄）共有房屋78幢，其中8幢临街。弄堂内房屋租金为30美元，临街房屋为88美元。水费由物业所有者、贝佩台182号 Sai Shing Land Company（音译）承担。由于水费和地税大幅增加，该公司于9月1日通知租户，自10月1日起租金增加10美元。
租户尚未表明态度，但136号租户周金才（Chew King Tsai，音译）强烈反对涨价。他正计划组织租户协会与房东进行谈判。他于9月3日将此意图通知了邻居。

我们就阿尔伯特王路怡安里（800弄）租户与物业经理 Marcel Darre 公司之间因涨租引发的纠纷已提交多份报告。
部分租户照常支付原有租金。其他受涨价影响的租户已将租金交至第二特区法院。他们聘请了邱汉平（Chiu Han Ping，音译）通过法院解决纠纷。

难民救济

由救世军管理的西卡威路国际救济委员会第二难民营管理层决定，在难民营内为有职业的难民设立工作部门。
在难民营外找到工作的难民须将其每日收入的30%上交管理层。

劳工运动

所谓的人力车夫代表陈国良（Chen Kuo Liang，音译）、陈茂荣（Chen Mow Yung，音译）和金应龙（Chin Ying Lung，音译）前往广东路98号三北轮船公司办公室，以及宁波路86号金华航运公司，拜访工部局华董俞亚清先生和袁履登先生，请求他们协助改组车夫互助会，并使该会此后由车夫自行管理。
俞先生和袁先生未接见来访者。

华成烟草厂的36名工人昨日在南京路中国工业银行领取了遣散费。

Incident on Night Soil Jetty on Route Zikawei

Despite the negotiations by the contractor Chang
Chien Tang, the Japanese sentries near Sin Tu Road bridge,
opposite the night soil jetty of Route de Zikawei, are continuing
to arrest the crew of night soil boats who go ashore in the
French Concession to obtain payment for the removal of night
soil.
At 4.30 p.m. yesterday four boatmen were arrested
by the Japanese. They were released after having been severely
manhandled.
The boatmen are now afraid to enter the Zafuang Creek.

Night Soil Removal in French Concession

On the morning of September 5, a total of 964 cart-
loads of night soil were removed from the French Concession.
The contents of 690 carts were discharged into 35
boats at the jetty on Route de Zikawei.

pages.en:
FRENCH POLICE DAILY REPORT
AUGUST 12.
Shanghai
15 S 38

The Reformed Government and the Shanghai
Administrative Office have decided to celebrate August 13
as "The Anniversary of the Rebirth of China." On this
occasion, associations and groups affiliated to these
regimes will mobilize their members to conduct meetings and
distribute pamphlets. Persuaded, however, that these meetings
will be impossible to be held in the Concessions due to the
special precautions adopted by the authorities concerned,
they are preparing a " Nautical Procession" on the Whangpoo.

Chinese patriotic societies have had sent through
the mails anti-Japanese leaflets to local residents whose
names figure in the Telephone Book. Most of the envelopes,
which bear the names of spurious business houses, have
escaped the postal censors' attentions and reached the
addresses.

法租界警务处日报
8月12日。
上海
15 S 38

维新政府与上海特别市政府决定将8月13日定为“中国复兴纪念日”。届时，隶属于这些政权的协会和团体将动员其成员举行集会并散发传单。然而，鉴于有关当局采取了特别预防措施，他们意识到在租界内举行此类集会将是不可能的，因此正筹备在黄浦江举行一次“水上游行”。

中国爱国团体已通过邮件向电话簿上列有姓名的当地居民寄发反日传单。大多数信封上印有虚假商号名称，避过了邮政检查员的注意，并已送达收件人地址。

FRENCH POLICE DAILY REPORT JULY 9.

General LI WEN YEN, Commander of the 53rd Division
has been appointed Commander of the 16th Army vice General
LI PAO PING, transferred to another post. He has been
replaced by General HO NGU YUN, Deputy Commander of the
53rd Division. The 16th Army is now operating in
Southern Anhwei.

Copies of a leaflet containing pro-Reformed Government
caricatures are now being circulated in Shanghai. They
are being distributed with the "Sin Shun Pao," Chinese
language propaganda newspaper of the Japanese Authorities.

The Health Department of the French Concession on
July 8, disposed of several dozen coffins by incineration
in a piece of waste ground at Tong Tse King near Zikawei
Railway Station.

At 10.30 a.m. July 8, a motor car bearing no licence,
carrying three plain-clothes Japanese and two Chinese,
stopped at the corner of Fukien and Ningpo Roads. Leaving
their car the Japanese arrested in Ningpo Road a Chinese
aged about 30. An S.M.P. officer, perceiving what had
happened, tried to intervene. The Japanese, however,
drew their pistols and refused to permit him to interfere
stating that the person arrested was an agitator. They
left in the direction of Hongkew with the Chinese.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 12.7.38）

Translation of French Police Report No. 2606/1 8039 A
dated 14.5.38.

Subject:- Transportation of machinery and
effects of the Yi Hou Rubber Factory,
from Nantao to the French Concession.

The Yi Hou (義和) Rubber Factory is located at
1252 Wu Ming Nan To Road (near Rue de l'Arsenal), Nantao.
Mr. Sou Kong Sieh (蘇公選), the owner, intends to move
his machinery and effects (some 20 truck loads), now in the
premises of the factory, into the Concessions. The Japanese
firm of "Sho Lee and Company," 141 Kiangse Road, has been
entrusted with the task of removal. This Company, having
secured a permit from the Japanese Military Police in
Nantao, has instructed the Dah Kung Transportation Company,
10/269 Foochow Road, to supply the trucks and carry out the
moving operations.

Three trucks will be employed for the work. Part
of the machinery and office equipment will be stored in
a depot constructed on a plot of waste ground at the corner
of Tonquin-Penang Roads. Part will also be taken to a
newly built house situated in front of 26, Ping Yuen Fang,
Route Cassini.

Dc (Dir)
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 17 MAY 1938）

法国警察报告第2606/1 8039 A号译文，日期为1938年5月14日。

主题：将义和橡胶厂的机器及物品从南市运至法租界。

义和（義和）橡胶厂位于南市武鸣南路1252号（靠近兵工厂路）。厂主苏公选（Sou Kong Sieh，音译）先生打算将其目前存放在厂内的机器及物品（约20卡车的装载量）搬入租界。江西路141号的日本商号“Sho Lee and Company”（音译）已受托负责搬迁工作。该公司在获得南市的日本宪兵队颁发的许可证后，指示福州路10/269号的大功运输公司（Dah Kung Transportation Company）提供卡车并执行搬迁作业。

此项工作将使用三辆卡车。部分机器和办公设备将储存在 Tonquin-Penang 路拐角处一块荒地上建造的仓库中。部分物品也将运至卡西尼路（Route Cassini）平远坊26号对面的一栋新建房屋内。

Dc (Dir)
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别处 1938年5月17日）

To the French Consul-General,

Having received instructions from Messrs.
Sho Lee & Company, I have to request your
indulgence in issuing three permits for the
transportation into the Concessions, via St.
Catherine's Bridge, of machinery and effects now
stored at 1252 Min To Road, Nantao.

Yours etc.,
Dah Kung Transportation Co.
(Signed) Tung King Kwei.

- 2 -
At 1.30 p.m. 8.3.38 a launch carrying 8 armed
Japanese soldiers and ten Chinese moored alongside the
s.s. "Chaksang" lying at Roosevelt Terminal. The soldiers
accompanied the Chinese onto the steamer, whence the latter
removed some ten bags of opium onto the launch which moved
off in a northerly direction.

French Police Daily Report - March 10

At 3.15 a.m. March 10, members of the French Police
discovered the decapitated head of a Chinese at the corner
of Rue Ratard - Lorton. A paper bearing the following
inscription in Chinese was found close to the head:-
"Motives for the execution: he was a member of the
Chinese mobile units. We beheaded him to-day and are
exposing this head to the public gaze. You will suffer
the same fate if you do not modify your activities.

The head was sent to the mortuary on Route Delastre.

French Police Daily Report - February 10, 1938

The Training Division (General Chi Chwang Chien)
formerly the Peace Preservation Corps (Paoantui) in
Shang'ai, which was reorganised during last November,
has been transformed into the new 11th Division. It is
composed of two infantry brigades, each comprising two
regiments. Each regiment has a machine-gun company and
a trench mortar company. In addition, the division
possesses an artillery unit and a squadron of cavalry.
It is said to be some 10,000 men strong. The reorganised
division is now garrisoned at Kian in Kiangsi. General
Chi Chwang Chien has as his deputy, Colonel Weng Hwa
Shou, a former cadet at St. Cyr, (Translator's note:-
St. Cyr is the French equivalent of Sandhurst), and the
former deputy commander of the Paoantui in Shanghai. His
Chief of Staff is Colonel Yo Ching, former commander of
the 1st Regiment of Paoantui.

The 1st Brigade of the new 11th Division is
under the command of Colonel Weng Hwa Shou and the 2nd
Brigade under Colonel Tai Hsueh Chi, former Chief of
the 2nd Regiment of Paoantui.

TRANSLATION OF FRENCH POLICE REPORT NO. 2175/S DATED 29.1.38.
SUBJECT: Organisation by the Japanese of a Chinese
Provisional Government in Central China.

CONFIDENTIAL

Recently the Japanese authorities have been paying
particular attention to the creation of a Chinese
Provisional Government in Central China, with bureaux
in Nanking, similar to the Government in North China,
already existing in Peking.

Among the well-to-do Chinese who are reported to
have been already approached by the Japanese or with
whom the latter are said to be desirous of entering
into contact, are, according to Japanese sources,
Mr. TANG SHAO YI (唐绍儀), former collaborator of
Dr. SUN YAT SEN, the former Foreign Minister to the
Peking Government and Prefect of Chunshan (Kwangtung),
Mr. LI SZE HAO (李思浩), former Finance Minister
to the Peking Government, Mr. WANG SHAO LAI (王曉籟),
President of the Chamber of Commerce in Shanghai, at
present in Hongkong, and Mr. WANG TSE HUI (王子惠),
a native of Fukien, whose curriculum vitae is not yet
known. Certain of the negotiations are said to be
in the hands of Mr. YUAN TSU LIANG (袁左良), former
Chief Accountant of the Kincheng Banking Corporation in
Peking, who arrived in Shanghai in September 1937. Mr.
YUAN is at present residing at No. 51 Rue Massenet.

The inauguration of the new Government, it is
said, will take place towards the Lunar New Year
(January 31), upon which date all the necessary pre-
parations will be finished.

It is difficult to believe, however, that such
personalities as TANG SHAO YI and WANG SHAO LAI will
consent ot work hand in hand with the Japanese.
(Mr. TANG, 76 years, lives with his son-in-law Mr.
CHU CHANG NIEN, Superintendent of Customs in Shanghai -
now in Hongkong - at No. 18 Route Ferguson. He is
at present sick and receives no visitors)

P. A. to D. C (Sp. Br.)

法租界警务报告第2175/S号译文，日期1938年1月29日。
主题：日本人在华中组织中国临时政府。

机密

近期，日本当局特别关注在华中地区
建立一个中国临时政府，并在南京设立办
事处，类似于目前已在北京存在的华北政
府。

据日方消息来源称，在已被日本人接
触或据称日本人希望与之接触的富裕华人
中，包括唐绍仪先生，前孙中山博士的合作
者、前北京政府外交总长及广东中山县县长；
李思浩先生，前北京政府财政总长；王晓籁
先生，上海总商会会长，目前在香港；以及
王子惠先生，福建人，其履历尚不清楚。据
称部分谈判由袁子良先生负责，他是前北京
金城银行总会计师，于1937年9月抵达上海。
袁先生目前居住在马思南路51号。

据悉，新政府的成立将在农历新年
（1月31日）左右举行，届时所有必要的准
备工作都将完成。

然而，很难相信像唐绍仪和王晓籁这
样的人物会同意与日本人携手合作。
（唐先生，76岁，与其女婿朱昌年先生同
住，朱先生任上海海关税务司——目前在
香港——住址为费伦路18号。他目前患病，
谢绝访客）

P. A. 致 D. C (特别支部)

pages.en:
It is said, however, in certain Japanese circles that
Major-General UCHIDA, of the Special Service Section
of the Japanese Army, who is reported to have arrived
in Shanghai on about January 10 and to have returned
to Tokyo on about January 16, held certain conferences
with numerous Chinese personalities having pro-Japanese
tendencies in Shanghai. General UCHIDA, who is supposed
to have resided at the New Asia Hotel during his stay
here, is said to have taken the list of members of
the future government back with him for approval by
Tokyo.
in Shanghai
The arrival/is reported on January 16 of Major
General MATSUMARO, who is said to have been appointed
adviser to the new government and who will play in
Nanking, the same role that General KITA is now
playing in Peking. General MATSUMARO is supposed to
be residing at the New Asia Hotel, corner of North Sze-
chuen and Tiendong Roads.
pages.zh:
然而，据某些日本方面人士称，日本陆军
特务机关长内田少将（据报于1月10日左右抵
达上海，并于1月16日左右返回东京）在上海
与众多具有亲日倾向的中国名人举行了会谈。
据说内田将军在此停留期间居住在新亚酒店，
并将未来政府成员名单带回东京以待批准。
在上海
据报松室少将于1月16日抵达，据说他
已被任命为新政府顾问，并将在南京扮演北
喜多将军目前在北京所扮演的角色。据说松
室将军居住在四川北路与天潼路转角的新亚
酒店。

在上海

NOTICE FOR THE PRESS

In view of the explosives of a crude manufacture
discovered in various places of the Concession during the
past weeks, the French Authorities draw the attention of
all residents to the danger of handling these objects.

In the event of an object of this nature being
found, persons who discover its presence are earnestly re-
quested:-

1/. Not to touch the suspected object, but to leave
it exactly as it was found.

2/. Immediately to notify the French Police ( Te-
lephone 70060 ) who will take the necessary steps for its
removal.

It is particularly important that parents warn
their children strictly against playing with any objects
found on public roads, in the gardens and on pieces of va-
cant land.

This warning also applies to military bombs etc.
of all kinds.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 18 JAN 1938）

pages.en:
NOTE POUR LA PRESSE

Au cours des dernières semaines, des engins explosifs rudimentaires ayant été découverts en différents endroits dans la Concession, les Autorités Françaises attirent l'attention des résidents sur le danger qu'il y a à manipuler ces engins.

Dans toutes les circonstances où un objet de cette nature serait découvert, les personnes qui en auraient constaté la présence sont instamment priées:
1°/ - De ne pas toucher à l'objet suspect et de le laisser en l'état actuel;
2°/ - D'en donner immédiatement avis à la Police Française (Téléphone 70060) qui fera le nécessaire pour l'enlèvement.

Il est particulièrement important que les parents défendent à leurs enfants de jouer avec les objets ramassés sur la voie publique, dans les jardins et les terrains vagues.

Ces recommandations s'appliquent également aux explosifs de guerre de toute nature./.

French Military Bulletin dated 13/1/38

The 37th Army under Gen. Mao Ping Wen, has been transferred at the beginning of January from south Anhwei to Hupeh and Kiangsi. The Headquarters of the Army is established in Hankow while its units are distributed as follows:-

96th Division - Hankow
98th Division - Kiukiang
3rd Artillery Regiment - Kiukiang.

The Japanese 1st Division has been recalled from the Hangchow front to Shanghai thence it will be transferred to another front. An artillery detachment of this Division left on January 11 on board three transports for some unknown destination.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL / [签名] / 14 JAN 1938 / SPECIAL BRANCH）

Military operations

Japanese troops disembarked at Tsingtao on the morning of January 12 and marched westward along the Tsinan-Tsingtao railway. They will effect a junction with another column of the Japanese troops who are proceeding eastward from Weihsien.

The Japanese Military authorities announced that Tsining was captured by Mumata and Kuwata detachments on January 10 after several days fighting. The troops under Gen. Chao Fu Ling (6th Army of Shantung Province) who defended Tsining, have retreated to Auchudhen, 15 klm. to the south-west of Tsining.

毛炳文（Mao Ping Wen）将军麾下的第37军已于1月初从皖南调往湖北和江西。该军司令部设在汉口，其部队部署如下：-

第96师 - 汉口
第98师 - 九江
第3炮兵团 - 九江。

日本第1师团已从杭州前线召回上海，随后将调往另一前线。该师团的一个炮兵分队于1月11日乘坐三艘运输船前往某未知目的地。

（印：上海公共租界 / [签名] / 1938年1月14日 / 特别股）

军事行动

日军于1月12日上午在青岛登陆，并沿津浦铁路（济南-青岛段）向西进发。他们将与另一支从潍县向东推进的日军纵队会合。

日本军方宣布，经过数日战斗，牟田（Mumata）和桑田（Kuwata）支队于1月10日攻占济宁。防守济宁的赵福林（Chao Fu Ling）将军（山东省第6军）麾下部队已撤退至济宁西南15公里处的澳陈店（Auchudhen，音译）。

Following the capture of Tsinling, the Japanese have
despatched a detachment to march towards Kweiteh (Shangkiu),
an important city on the Lunghai Railway situated between
Hsuchow and Kaifeng. As a consequence the numerous Chinese
troops at present concentrated in Hsuchow will be obliged
to abandon the region in order to avoid an encirclement by
the Japanese.

The port of Tsingtao has been blockaded by Chinese with
nine naval ships of the 3rd Chinese Squadron. Passengers
and merchandise have to disembark on to tug boats outside
the port. In the meantime Japanese marines are making
arrangements to destroy the boom and it is expected that
normal transportation service in the port would be resumed
in the near future.

------

Naval operations

60 Japanese marines landed on the Sanchou Island,
11 miles north-east of Kukok Ngao Kok Island, on January 10.
It will be recalled that this island was occupied by the
Japanese on December 5, 1937 but they withdrew in the latter
half of the month.

The Japanese garrison forces on the Kukok Ngao Kok
Island will be reinforced.

------

Aerial operations

On January 11, one squadron of Japanese planes bombarded
Nanning, capital of Kwangsi Province, They subsequently
proceeded to attack Liuchow, 160 klm. north-east of Nanning,
where they met a number of Chinese pursuit planes. As a result
of the combat, two Japanese aeroplanes were brought down.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

继占领济宁后，日军派遣一支支队向归德（商丘）进发，归德是陇海铁路上位于徐州和开封之间的一座重要城市。因此，目前集中在徐州的大量中国军队将被迫放弃该地区，以避免被日军包围。

青岛港已被中国海军第三舰队的九艘军舰封锁。乘客和货物必须在港外换乘拖船上下。与此同时，日本海军陆战队正在安排破坏封锁线，预计港口正常运输服务将在不久的将来恢复。

------

海军行动

1月10日，60名日本海军陆战队员在九角澳角岛（Kukok Ngao Kok Island，音译）东北11英里的三洲岛（Sanchou Island，音译）登陆。值得注意的是，该岛曾于1937年12月5日被日军占领，但他们在当月下半月撤离。

驻守九角澳角岛的日军守备部队将获得增援。

------

空中行动

1月11日，一队日本飞机轰炸了广西省会南宁。随后，他们转而攻击南宁东北160公里处的柳州，在那里遭遇了中国多架驱逐机。战斗结果是两架日本飞机被击落。

On January 12, fifteen Japanese planes bombarded
Nanchang, capital of Kiangsi Province; a number of Chinese
planes and military camps were destroyed as a result of the
raid.

On the same day, a Japanese squadron consisting of
22 aeroplanes attacked Pakhoi, south-west of Kwangtung.
Yintak and Pakong Hsiens on the Canton-Hankow Railway and
Cheungmuktow on the Canton-Kowloon Railway were also bombed
by these planes.

In the South Anhwei, Japanese military trains were bombed
by Chinese aeroplanes at Suancheng, 63 klm. to the south-east
of Wuhu on the Kiangnan Railway.

----------

The Bureau of Police established at the Chiao Tung
University, Avenue Haig, issued on the morning of January 12
600 passes to refugees desirous of inspecting their property
in Nantao, Pootung and ████ areas beyond the Settlement.

--

19,914 refugees were encamped in the French Concession
on January 12, 1938.

3,800 persons arrived in Shanghai from Ningpo and
Nantungchow on January 12 while 820 persons left on the
same day for Ningpo.

1月12日，十五架日本飞机轰炸了江西省会南昌；此次空袭摧毁了多架中国飞机和军营。

同日，一支由22架飞机组成的日本中队袭击了广东西南部的北海。粤汉铁路上的英德和琶江（Pakong，音译）县，以及广九铁路上的樟木头也遭到这些飞机的轰炸。

在皖南，中国飞机在江南铁路芜湖东南63公里处的宣城（Suancheng，音译）轰炸了日本军用列车。

----------

设立在海格路交通大学的警察局于1月12日上午向希望前往南市、浦东及租界外 ████ 地区查看财产的难民发放了600张通行证。

--

1938年1月12日，法租界内收容难民19,914人。

1月12日，3,800人从宁波和南通抵达上海，同日有820人离开上海前往宁波。

TRANSLATIONS OF EXTRACTS FROM FRENCH POLICE INTELLIGENCE
REPORT DATED DECEMBER 23, 1937.
------------------------------------

A new Army - the 72nd - has just been formed.
It is composed of the 67th. and 88th Divisions. Its
commander is General SUN YUAN LIANG, the former Commander-
in-Chief of the 71st Army.

The 71st army, comprising the 36th. and 87th
Divisions, has been placed under the command of General
WANG KING KIU, deputy chief of this army.

These two armies are now operating in the region
of Siaofeng-Anchi to the north-west of Hangchow.
------------

Four Japanese transports arrived in Shanghai on
December 22 and landed about 200 marines and munitions.
The transport "Hide Maru" left Shanghai at 2 p.m. on
December 22 with 500 horses for an unknown destination.
------------

The Japanese are pursuing their operations
against Hangchow. The Japanese High Command announces
that troops are pressing onto the provincial capital
of Chekiang from three sides; one (KATAGIRI, HORIEI,
KOZOE and FUJIAMA detachments.) occupied Anchi on
December 20. During the afternoon of December 21,
Siaofeng (60 kms. North-West of Hangchow) was attacked but
considerable resistance was met with.

Another column (YAMADA, FUKUI, TANIGAWA AND TSURA
detachments) operating along the Nanking-Hangchow
highway, took Mokanshan from the Chinese forces on the
morning of December 22. The same afternoon Japanese
units approached Tsuhsing and Wakang, some 40 kms. to
the north and north-west of Hangchow.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER）
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL 23 DEC 1937）
（批：Dec B.）
（批：S.1- K.1.V.）
（批：24/12）

1937年12月23日法国警察情报报告摘录译文。
------------------------------------

一支新军队——第72军——刚刚组建。它由第67师和第88师组成。其指挥官是孙元良（SUN YUAN LIANG）将军，前任第71军总司令。

第71军包括第36师和第87师，已由该军副司令王敬久（WANG KING KIU）将军指挥。

这两支军队目前正在杭州西北的小丰（Siaofeng，音译）-安吉（Anchi）地区作战。
------------

四艘日本运输船于12月22日抵达上海，卸下约200名海军陆战队员和弹药。“日出丸”（Hide Maru）运输船于12月22日下午2时离开上海，载有500匹马前往未知目的地。
------------

日军正在继续对杭州的作战行动。日本大本营宣布，部队正从三面向浙江省会施压；其中一路（片桐（KATAGIRI）、堀井（HORIEI）、小曾（KOZOE）和藤山（FUJIAMA）支队）于12月20日占领安吉。12月21日下午，小丰（杭州西北60公里）遭到攻击，但遭遇了顽强抵抗。

另一纵队（山田（YAMADA）、福井（FUKUI）、谷川（TANIGAWA）和都留（TSURA）支队）沿宁杭公路作战，于12月22日上午从中国军队手中夺取莫干山。同日下午，日军部队逼近杭州以北和西北约40公里处的褚星（Tsuhsing，音译）和瓦康（Wakang，音译）。

（印：副总巡）
（印：上海工部局 1937年12月23日）

A third colum, working along the Shanghai-Hangchow
Railway line, reached Changan (39 kms. north-west of
Hangchow) during the afternoon of December 22. Fighting
is being continued in that area.
----------
The Japanese authorities are reported to have
proposed to Mr. LING KANG HOU(he studied in Japan),
Secretary-General of the Chinese Bankers' Association,
that he assume the functions of Mayor of Shanghai.
Mr. Ling is reported to have proceeded to Hongkong
for the purpose of obtaining permission from the
Central Authorities to take over this post, but as
far as can be ascertained no agreement has yet been
reached.

At present the Japanese turning to Mr. FU SIAO
AN, managing director of the Commercial Bank of China.
Mr. FU is said to have accepted this post in principle,
but before giving a definite answer, he is reported to
desire the support of Mr. CHANG SIAO LING, Chinese
member of the French Municipal Council. Following
a recent disagreement on the subject of the withdrawal
of certain funds from the Chung Wei Bank by Mr. FU,
which was refused by Mr. Chang, who is a member of the
Board of Directors of this bank, it seems that no
understanding will be possible between these two
gentlemen.
----------
24,965 refugees in camps, etc. in the French Concession
on December 22.
----------
1300 passengers (refugees) etc. arrived in Shanghai on
December 22 from Tantungchow and Tientsin, whilst 800
left for Tinghai (Chekiang) on the same day.

----------
据报道，日本当局已向中国银行家协会秘书长凌康侯（LING KANG HOU，曾留学日本）先生提议，由其担任上海市市长。据悉，凌先生已前往香港，旨在获得中央当局批准以接任此职，但据查目前尚未达成协议。

目前，日本人转向中国商业银行总经理傅筱庵（FU SIAO AN）先生。据说傅先生在原则上已接受此职，但在给出明确答复前，据悉他希望得到法公董局华董张晓林（CHANG SIAO LING）先生的支持。鉴于傅先生最近因从中威银行提取某些资金一事与身为该行董事的张先生发生分歧并遭拒绝，看来这两位先生之间无法达成谅解。
----------

----------

Four Japanese transports arrived in Shanghai
on December 20, landing 30 trucks, 200 large cases
of explosives, gasolene, munitions and supplies. On
the same day about 14,000 troops embarked on four
other transports which left Shanghai for an unknown
destination.
---
The Japanese continue to progress towards Hangchow.
Units operating along the Nanking-Hangchow highway have
dislodged the Chinese from positions at at Tsingsha.
Japanese outposts are reported to have reached Shan-
kiaopu, 3 kms. north of Wukang on the morning of
December 20. Japanese armoured trains have been
observed on the Shanghai-Hangchow Rly. at Changan,
39 kms. north-east of Hangchow. One column,
operating along the Shanghai-Hangchow highway is
nearing Haining. In order to facilitate these
operations landings were made on the 19th. at Wengkiapu
and Paishih, spots located on the north bank of
the Tsientangkiang at 20 and 11 kms. to the east

---
On the north bank of the Yangtze, Japanese
forces operating along the Grand Canal, occupied on

Kaoyu. Reconnaissance detachments have been observed
near Shaopu, 25 kms. to the north of Yangchow..
---
On the Tsingpu Railway Line, the Japanese occupied
Wuyi on the 18th. and Chuchow (Chun sien) on the 19th.
The Chinese have withdrawn towards Chengpuling, 35 kms.
north-west of Pakow.

四艘日本运输船于12月20日抵达上海，卸下30辆卡车、200大箱炸药、汽油、军火及补给品。同日，约14,000名士兵登上另外四艘运输船，离开上海前往未知目的地。

日军继续向杭州推进。沿南京-杭州公路作战的部队已将中国军队从青沙（Tsingsha）阵地驱逐。据报，12月20日上午，日军前哨已到达武康以北3公里的沈家埠（Shankiaopu）。在杭州东北39公里的长安镇，有人观察到沪杭铁路上有日军装甲列车。一支部队沿沪杭公路推进，正逼近海宁。为便利这些行动，日军于19日在翁家埠（Wengkiapu）和白石（Paishih）登陆，这两处位于钱塘江北岸，分别在杭州以东20公里和11公里处。
